hooks.name: Keep the engineering log current
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to append an entry to docs/ENGINEERING-LOG.md whenever a carrier adapter, the session core, or the logging/security layer is modified, so the failure/fix history stays current instead of decaying.

action.prompt:
You just modified a file in the carrier adapter, session core, browser, telemetry, diagnostics or logging layer.

If this change fixed a bug, worked around carrier behaviour, or removed a footgun, append an entry to docs/ENGINEERING-LOG.md before you finish:

- Use the next sequential F-NN number; never reuse one.
- Use the template at the top of that file.
- Record the actual evidence: the verbatim error string, HTTP status, response body, or log line. A status code is a category; a response body is an answer.
- State what you ruled out, not just the conclusion. Most of the cost is in the wrong hypotheses.
- If the fix guards against silent reintroduction, add or cite a test and mark the code LOAD-BEARING.
- Never paste credentials, tokens or cookies, even expired ones.

If the change was purely cosmetic or a refactor with no behavioural lesson, skip it — the log is for surprises, not for every commit.

Also update the Timeline table and the "Still open" section if the status of anything changed.
